items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: Dick, I've been lucky all my life.

ctx.x: Did you ever find any money?

Oh, I found lots of money. Dick, I've been lucky all my life. I found $5 bills. I found loads of money. Oh, lots of nickels, dimes, and quads. I look like these things, like magnets. I walk and find them. I have a little pocket with my wallet that I carry with all types of coins and bills that I found. I keep them as a superstition girl. So I'm going to save this, I'll find some more. Which is a common thing for a person to do. And I'll even find a fine man. I found money underneath the sand. I want to be a…
What do people leave behind when they're in a nightclub? That's always a thing.
